svg.title: Coding agents connected by Rhizome
svg.desc: Eight coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Hermes, Antigravity CLI, GitHub Copilot and Amp) each run their own Rhizome node. Underground, the nodes form a root-like mesh with no hub, passing pub/sub messages, channel posts and gossip directly between each other over the local network.
svg.text: each session runs its own node · nodes talk directly · no hub
your network · LAN, Tailscale or VPN
